Set Up Git and Create a Repository
Before Git can record a project's history, Git must be available on your computer and the project folder must be a Git repository. We will not cover installation of Git in this lesson but you can follow the instructions on this page to install it on your operating system.
In this lesson we will take the example of the developer-handbook project from the previous lesson. You will verify that Git is installed, check the author details Git will attach to future commits, and turn an ordinary folder into a repository.
